fusions.name: Fish in a Barrel
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow that deals 5 damage. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction on the target, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Staking Shot
fusions.desc: A full-draw shot deals 28 damage, up to 1.5 times that at 8 tiles, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Cinch Line
fusions.desc: Strings a line 5 tiles long ahead of you for 6 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Nocked and Waiting
fusions.desc: When you put a condition on an enemy, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
